title: The best guide Xavi
text:
One of the best excursions we have done in a long time. Montserrat is a place that leaves you speechless, majestic and full of magic, and the visit to the winery with the wine tasting was the perfect finishing touch to end the day.

All of this would not have been the same without Xavi. An exceptional guide, very funny, approachable and with a passion that is contagious. He explains everything clearly, interactively and pleasantly, making you participate and enjoy every moment. You can tell that he loves what he does.

In addition, impeccable organization: we left on time and the entire itiner

title: Gat is cat in Catalán
text:
We started the day off with LOTS of fog and a bit of drizzle on our trip up to Moneserrat, but our guide Yerai and his compatriots made the best of it by still describing what laid behind the fog and cover. An emotional experience if you're one of religion.
He was quite personable and kept things serious but light hearted. He also taught my wife and I how to say cat in Catalán, which is "gat".
